work_order: In memory_system/store.py, add a role grant for the patient role to access confidential records when they are the patient themselves: add ('patient', 'confidential', 'self') to DEFAULT_ROLE_GRANTS. This ensures newly created episodes automatically have the correct authorization.

Modify the retrieve() method in memory_system/store.py to handle existing stores that were created before the patient-confidential grant existed. Specifically, in the gate-2 (RBAC) check, if role_grants has no row for (requester_role, sensitivity), and requester_role == 'patient' and requester_id == patient_id, treat the effective requires_rel as 'self' rather than denying. This preserves backward compatibility with stores that have not had the new grant inserted, without modifying role_grants data.
